safety.task_sessions: bridge session maps directly to BrowserCrew task session
safety.borrowed_tabs: not owned and cannot be closed by session cleanup
safety.approval: risky click or Enter returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED

read_page.purpose: bounded full-page/document extraction without expanding observe_page
read_page.frames: top-frame result may include readable frame_id/#f handles

find.purpose: fresh accessibility-tree search without guessing semantic refs

site_skill.create: fresh AX + bounded form evaluate + optional active network evidence -> persisted immutable candidate revision
site_skill.verify: append fresh structural evaluation evidence to a specific immutable revision
site_skill.run: active revision by default -> fresh verification -> fresh semantic target resolution -> parameterized execution; records inspectable execution evidence; non-GET/risky submission requires BrowserCrew approval proof
site_skill.refine: recollect fresh site evidence -> deterministic contract diff -> create a new candidate revision only when the contract changed; active revision is never mutated or moved
site_skill.history: immutable revisions + structural/execution evaluations + execution evidence + lifecycle events + active pointer + promotion gate
site_skill.promote: explicit only; same revision must have passing latest structural verification and execution evaluation; promotion responses include the candidate-vs-active comparison snapshot
site_skill.rollback: explicit revision_id; target must have been active previously
site_skill.lifecycle: candidate revisions are immutable; no auto-promotion; active revision pointer changes only through explicit promotion/rollback
site_skill.compare: compare candidate revision against explicit baseline or current active revision using structural outcome, execution counts, pass/fail rate, latest execution and deterministic regression/improvement signals

select_option.purpose: choose native select options using a fresh semantic ref and page input/change events

hover.purpose: move the real CDP pointer to a fresh semantic target and verify the intended element enters :hover

drag.purpose: real CDP drag/drop between two fresh semantic refs
verification: source and target hit-tests before dispatch
source down + target up delivery proof

send_keys.purpose: dispatch real CDP keyboard chords/sequences at the current focus
send_keys.mod_resolution: Cmd on macOS; Ctrl on Windows/Linux/ChromeOS
send_keys.approval: Enter-containing sequences preserve BrowserCrew approval policy

await_user_action.purpose: pause BrowserCrew planning for a human-only page step, then re-observe fresh state
await_user_action.behavior: 10-second navigation-first grace period, then takeover UI; navigation or user confirmation resumes; cancel stops

navigation.back: Chrome history back + bounded usable-document verification
navigation.reload: reload selected task tab with optional bypass_cache + bounded usable-document verification

close_session.purpose: close all task-owned tabs and delete the BrowserCrew task session
close_session.preserves: borrowed user tabs are never closed

working.automatic_updates: initial page + successful browser actions + human handoffs
working.payload_policy: tool input payloads are excluded; stores task/page/tool/target/Skill references only
working.retirement: cleared after final durable task episode is saved or when close_session runs

episodic.search: bounded deterministic lexical retrieval over task/title/sites/tools/targets/Skill refs
episodic.payload_policy: raw action inputs, typed text, uploads and Site Skill parameter values are not persisted

automatic_recall.planner_semantics: recalled episodes are labeled historical evidence only and never override current goal/fresh browser evidence
